gloss: front and back; two sides; duality

definitions.explanation: The two physical surfaces of something, such as fabric or paper.

definitions.gloss: two-facedness; duality; discrepancy between appearance and reality
definitions.explanation: The contrast between one's public persona and true nature, or between what is shown and what is hidden.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{布|ぬの}→布：01489_nuno⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{表裏|おもてうら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{区別|くべつ}→区別：01555_kubetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つき→付く：01960_tsuku⟧⟦にくい→〜にくい：02005_nikui⟧。
examples.english: It's hard to tell the front from the back of this fabric.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{表裏|おもてうら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}えて→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧⟦{印刷|いんさつ}→印刷：01844_insatsu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: I printed on the wrong side of the paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦コイン→コイン：10852_koin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{表裏|おもてうら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{施|ほどこ}されて→施す：12985_hodokosu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Different designs are applied to the front and back of this coin.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{表裏|おもてうら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: She has a straightforward personality (no hidden sides).

examples.japanese: ⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{表裏|おもてうら}⟦{一体|いったい}→一体：01731_ittai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In the world of politics, there are often two sides of the same coin.

notes:
FORMS:
- {表|おもて} (front, surface) + {裏|うら} (back, reverse)

ALTERNATE READING:
- ひょうり - more formal, used in written contexts

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {表裏|おもてうら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (straightforward, what you see is what you get)
- {表裏|おもてうら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (two-faced, hypocritical)
- {表裏|おもてうら}⟦{一体|いったい}→一体：01731_ittai⟧ (two sides of the same coin)

SIMILAR COMPOUND WORDS:
- ⟦{内外|ないがい}→内外：05556_naigai⟧/うちそと (inside and outside)
- ⟦{上下|じょうげ}→上下：04282_jouge⟧/うえした (top and bottom)
- ⟦{左右|さゆう}→左右：02826_sayuu⟧ (left and right)
- ⟦{前後|ぜんご}→前後：04042_zengo⟧ (front and back, before and after)
